column4: Resolve refuses `Self` outside an impl first (probe: `fn f() -> Self` is E0109 at resolve), so Elab never meets it; a compiler invariant
Resolve refuses an undeclared variable first (probe: `return y;` is E0100 at resolve), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Resolve refuses a call of an undeclared function first (probe: `return g();` is E0101 at resolve), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Resolve refuses a reference to an undeclared function first (probe: `let h: fn() -> u8 = g;` is E0100 at resolve), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Resolve refuses an assignment to an undeclared variable first (probe: `y = 1;` is E0100 at resolve), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Resolve refuses a borrow of an undeclared variable first (probe: `&y` is E0100 at resolve), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Resolve refuses a struct literal of an undeclared type first (probe: `S { a: 1 }` with no `S` is E0102 at resolve), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant

no compiler module emits it (`ElabError.code` has no case for it; the ledger row is its only occurrence), and the access it described, postfix `->`, is refused at parse (probe: `p->a` is E0001); a compiler invariant
Check refuses a field the struct does not have first (probe: `s.b` on `struct S { a: u8 }` is E0251 at check), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Check refuses a field access on a value that is not a struct first (probe: `x.a` with `x: u8` is E0254 at check), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Resolve refuses an undeclared enum first (probe: `E::A` with no `E` is E0105 at resolve), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Resolve refuses a variant the enum does not have first (probe: `E::C` on `enum E { A, B }` is E0103 at resolve), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant

Check refuses a variant literal whose fields do not match the variant first (probes: `E::A {}` and `E::A { y: 1 }` on `A { x: u8 }` are both E0252, missing field 'x', at check), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Check refuses a method call on a type variable with no such method first (probe: `x.go()` with `x: T` is E0265 at check), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Check refuses a call of a method the type does not have first (probe: `s.go()` on a struct without `go` is E0264 at check), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
Check refuses a method call on a value of a type that is not named first (probe: `x.go()` with `x: u8` is E0264 at check), so Elab never meets one; a compiler invariant
no compiler module raises it (`ElabError.inSubmodule` is declared, rendered and given this code, and never constructed), so no program reaches it; a compiler invariant
